```{r}

library(tidyverse)
bikeshare <- read_csv("data/bikeshare-2012.csv")
```

```{r}
ggplot(data = bikeshare, aes(x = temperature, y = count)) +
  geom_point() + 
  labs(x = "Temperature (in Celsius)", 
       y = "Bike rentals", 
       title = "Daily bike rentals versus temperature", 
       subtitle = "Capital Bikeshare 2012")
```
